fold5_reuse_note: Fold 5 (test=P02/P06/P12) is IDENTICAL train/val/test membership to the already-completed corrected single-fold result (results/galaxyppg_hr_corrected_eligibility_stage3.json) - independently re-verified this sprint by re-deriving the fold assignment from scratch and confirming exact set equality.
